name: remopilot
description: Use one conversation to operate one selected paired computer (1:1), or coordinate tasks across several (1:many). Inspect and edit project files, run commands, track background jobs and recover original results using each computer’s available capabilities.

positive.prompt: Which computers do I have paired?
positive.expected_behavior: List the account’s paired computers with their identifiers and platform, and state that pairing is completed by the user.

positive.description: Read a project file on one machine
positive.prompt: Use the sample computer to summarise README.md in the sample project.
positive.expected_behavior: Bind only the sample directory, validate the target tool schema, read the file on that computer and summarise it with the execution reference.

positive.description: Edit a file and run the project tests
positive.prompt: Change the greeting in the sample project and run its test command.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the edit on the bound computer, run the existing test command, and report the exit code with the returned output.

positive.description: Recover a background task by original request
positive.prompt: Resume the build I started earlier and show its original result.
positive.expected_behavior: Recover the original request and execution identifiers and read the stored result without re-running the work.

positive.description: Run work across two selected computers
positive.prompt: Run the test suite on both selected computers and compare the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Run on the two explicitly selected machines only, keep a separate execution record per machine, and compare their results.

negative.prompt: Pair my new laptop for me and type the six-digit code.
Read my Downloads folder on that Mac without asking me.
Run this on every computer in my account, including ones I have not selected.

review.commerce_description: RemoPilot does not sell products or process payments inside the plugin. This plugin shows no plans, prices or upgrade links; account and billing pages stay outside the plugin flow.

publication.release_notes: Initial public listing: six workflows for selecting paired computers, running and verifying project work, coordinating several computers, and recovering background tasks by original request.

zh-CN.subtitle: 一个对话操作已配对的电脑
zh-CN.description:
将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你已配对的电脑，支持两种模式。

1v1：一个对话操作一台选定电脑。检查环境、搜索和修改项目文件、运行命令、构建与验证改动、保存 Git 检查点；无需选择项目也能处理机器级任务。任务使用该电脑已有的工具和计算资源，命令按其系统用户权限执行。

1v多：同一个对话操作多台选定电脑，每台保留独立目标与执行记录。分别安排任务，并行执行互不依赖的工作，逐项跟踪进度并在对话中汇总结果。依赖任务在所需上游成功后继续；并行程度受共享资源和机器容量约束。

长任务可在执行期限内后台运行，之后查询日志和原始结果；连接中断时按原任务恢复。可保存任务摘要及引用，在新聊天中接续工作，恢复需要原执行电脑在线。

macOS 14 及以上可在具备桌面会话和系统权限时，通过辅助功能元素及窗口截图操作支持的应用独立实例。内置移动运行流程当前支持装有 Xcode 的 Mac 上的 iOS Simulator。

能力取决于每台选定电脑实际安装的运行时、操作系统、工具和权限。本插件提供连接与加载指引，不包含机器安装包。

使用前需要登录、安装 RemoPilot、在浏览器中配对电脑并启用所需能力。实际功能取决于机器、工具链和权限。选定文件、命令输出和截图可经中转返回聊天；持久执行记录留在执行电脑，云端保存账户与路由元数据。

interface.shortDescription: Run tasks on your paired computers from one chat
interface.longDescription:
RemoPilot runs work on the computers you have paired, from one ChatGPT or Codex conversation. Use it for remote development, editing project files, running and verifying commands, long background builds, and coordinating the same task across several machines. It supports two modes: 1:1 means one conversation operating one selected computer; 1:many means the same conversation operating multiple selected computers, with a separate target and execution record for each computer.

In 1:1 mode, inspect the selected computer, choose a project, search and edit files, run commands, build and verify changes, and save Git checkpoints. Machine tasks can run without selecting a project. Commands use the tools and computing resources already available on that computer.

In 1:many mode, assign work to each selected computer, run independent tasks in parallel, track each task separately and collect their results in the same conversation. Coordinate dependencies and start the next step after the required work succeeds. Shared resources and execution capacity can limit parallel work.

Long tasks can continue in the background within their execution limits. Return to their progress, logs and original results after a connection interruption. Save task summaries and original references for a new chat; recovery requires the original computer to be online.

On macOS 14 or later, inspect and interact with supported apps in dedicated background instances using accessibility elements and window screenshots. This requires a usable desktop session and the relevant system permissions. The managed mobile workflow currently builds, installs and runs iOS Simulator projects on a Mac with Xcode.

Capabilities depend on the installed runtime, operating system, tools and permissions reported by each selected computer. This plugin supplies connection and loading instructions; it does not include machine installers.

Sign in, install the RemoPilot runtime, pair each computer in the browser and enable the capabilities you need. Availability depends on the computer, installed tools and permissions. Commands run with its operating-system user permissions. Selected files, output and screenshots may be relayed into your chat; persistent execution records remain on the executing computer, while the cloud retains account and routing metadata.
